title: James Turrell
idiom: Haeckel-style scientific engraving with atmospheric wash — precise linework for the architectural aperture, soft tonal gradations for the sky field beyond it
hero_prompt: Wide 12:5 composition in Haeckel scientific engraving style with atmospheric colour wash: a stone ceiling aperture seen from below, edges drawn in precise architectural line, the sky beyond shifting from deep amber to violet in gradient washes of ink and watercolour — no figure visible, only the framing void and the luminous field it reveals. Dramatic darkened border around a glowing centre. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem in high-contrast screenprint style: a perfect circle cut into a flat plane, the circle filled with a gradient field from warm amber at edge to deep violet at centre — the aperture as pure geometric form. Thick clean lines only, no fine detail, no letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial. Survives at 24px.
